sections.text:
Item #1: Physicists have demonstrated the existence of a fourth property of electrons, the predicted electrical dipole moment.
Item #2: Researchers have discovered a method of using video game processors to improve CT scans, reducing the resulting radiation dose by greater than a factor of 10.
Item #3: Researchers find that a foreign accent reduces a person's perceived credibility.
